title: Fourier energy grouped by intersection
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $J,S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ with $S\subseteq J$. For each subset $T$ of the complement of $J$, form the frequency $S\cup T$. The sum of the squared Fourier coefficients at these frequencies equals the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients over all frequencies $U$ whose intersection with $J$ is exactly $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the sign cube of dimension $n$
$J$ and $S$ are subsets of the coordinate set
